segments.orig:
caiti tâ shyaothna varshta ýâ anghush astvå
verezyeiti fraêta apatita anuzvarshta ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza
atha bavaiñti peshô-tanva.
segments.en:
How many are the sins that men commit and that, being committed
and not confessed, nor atoned for, make their committer a Peshotanu?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, pañca ashâum
zarathushtra, paoirîm aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm
ýôi vereziñti mashyâka ýô
narem ashavanem anyô-varenâi vâ anyô-tkaêshâi
vâ kasyanghe sanghâi dadhâiti vîdhvå
avat hava xrathwa parâiti ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza
atha bavaiñti peshô-tanva.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'There are five such sins, O holy Zarathushtra!
It is the first of these sins that men commit when a man teaches
one of the faithful another faith, another law, a lower doctrine,
and he leads him astray with a full knowledge and conscience of
the sin: the man who has done the deed becomes a Peshotanu.

segments.orig:
bitîm aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm
ýôi vereziñti mashyâka ýô
sûne ýim pasush-haurve vâ vish-haurve vâ
astanãm ahmarshtanãm dadhâiti garemanãm
vâ hvarethanãm,
segments.en:
'It is the second of these sins when a man gives bones too
hard or food too hot to a shepherd's dog or to a house-dog;

segments.orig:
ýezica aête asti dâtâhva aråñte
garemôhva vîdhåñte ýat vâ
aête garema hvaretha stamanem vâ hizvãm vâ
apa-dazhat ahmat haca irishyât ýezi tat paiti irishyeiti
ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza atha bavaiñti peshô-tanva.
segments.en:
'If the bones stick in the dog's teeth or stop in his throat;
or if the food too hot burn his mouth or his tongue, he may come
to grief thereby; if he come to grief thereby, the man who has
done the deed becomes a Peshotanu.

segments.orig:
thritîm aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm
ýôi vereziñti mashyâka ýô
gadhwãm ýãm aputhrãm janaiti vâ
vayeiti vâ xraosyeiti vâ pazdayeiti vâ.

ýezica aêsha gadhwa maêkhe vâ câiti
vâ vaêmi vâ urûidhi vâ apô
vâ nâvayå paidhyâite ahmat haca irishyât
ýezi tat paiti irishyeiti ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza
atha bavaiñti peshô-tanva.
segments.en:
'If the bitch fall into a hole, or a well, or a precipice,
or a river, or a canal, she may come to grief thereby; if she
come to grief thereby, the man who has done the deed becomes a
Peshotanu.

segments.orig:
tûirîm aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm
ýôi vereziñti mashyâka ýô
nâirikãm cithravaitîm daxshtavaitîm vohunavaitîm
xshudrå avi frangherezaiti ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza
atha bavaiñti peshô-tanva.
segments.en:
'It is the fourth of these sins when a man has intercourse
with a woman who has the whites or sees the blood, the man that
has done the deed becomes a Peshotanu.

segments.orig:
puxdhem aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm ýôi
vereziñti mashyâka ýô nâirikãm
ýãm aputhrãm pipyûshîm vâ
apipyûshîm vâ anasaxtãm para xshudrå
avi frangherezaiti ahmat haca irishyât ýezi tat paiti
irishyeiti ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza atha bavaiñti
peshô-tanva!
segments.en:
'It is the fifth of these sins when a man has intercourse
with a woman quick with child, whether the milk has already come
to her breasts or has not yet come: she may come to grief thereby;
if she come to grief thereby, the man who has done the deed becomes
a Peshotanu.

segments.orig:
ýô kainînem upâiti stâtô-
ratûm vâ astâtô-ratûm vâ paradâtãm
vâ aparadâtãm vâ puthrãmca hê
dadhâiti mâ-nô aêsha ýâ kaine
mashyânãm parô fsharemât tarô daxshtem
pârayât tarô apemca urvarãmca.
segments.en:
'If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the
chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered [unto a
husband] or not delivered, and she conceives by him, let her
not, being ashamed of the people, produce in herself the menses,
against the course of nature, by means of water and plants.

segments.orig:
ýezica aêsha ýâ kaine mashyânãm
parô fsharemât tarô daxshtem parâiti tarô
apemca urvarãmca aêtahmâyush paiti varshta
shyaothna.
segments.en:
'And if the damsel, being ashamed of the people, shall produce
in herself the menses gainst the course of nature, by means of
water and plants, it is a fresh sin as heavy [as the first].

segments.orig:
ýô kainînem upâiti stâtô-
ratûm vâ astâtô-ratûm vâ paradâtãm
vâ aparadâtãm vâ puthrãmca hê
dadhâiti mâ-nô aêsha ýâ kaine
mashyânãm parô fsharemât hvatô
garewem raêshayât.
segments.en:
'If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the
chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered [unto a
husband] or not delivered, and she conceives by him, let her not,
being ashamed of the people, destroy the fruit in her womb.

segments.orig:
ýezica aêsha ýâ kaine mashyânãm
parô fsharemât hvatô garewem irishyeiti pterebyô
âstryeiti pterebyô irishyeiti pterebyô irishiñtãm
raêshê cikaên baodhô- varshtahe cithaya.
segments.en:
'And if the damsel, being ashamed of the people, shall destroy
the fruit in her womb, the sin is on both the father and herself,
the murder is on both the father and herself; both the father
and herself shall pay the penalty for wilful murder.

segments.orig:
ýô kainînem upâiti stâtô-
ratûm vâ astâtô-ratûm vâ paradâtãm
vâ aparadâtãm vâ puthrãmca hê
dadhâiti ýezica vaocât aêsha ýâ
kaine, puthrem aêm narô varshta ýezica vaocât
aêshô nâ hanãm aêtaêshãm
jîjishanguha peresanguha
segments.en:
'If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the
chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered [unto a
husband] or not delivered, and she conceives by him, and she says,
"I have conceived by thee;" and he replies, "Go
then to the old woman and apply to her for one of her drugs,
that she may procure thee miscarriage;"

segments.orig:
aêtadha aêsha ýâ kaine hanãm
aêtaêshãm jîjishâiti peresâiti
aêsha hana frabaraiti banghem vâ shaêtem vâ
khnânem vâ fraspâtem vâ kãmcit
vâ vîtâcinanãm urvaranãm, aêtahmât
puthrât mimarexshanguha aêtadha aêsha ýâ
kaine aêtahmât puthrât mimarxshâite havañta
aêtahe shyaothnahe verezyãn nâca kainica hanâca.
segments.en:
'And the damsel goes to the old woman and applies to her for
one of her drugs, that she may procure her miscarriage; and the
old woman brings her some Banga, or Shaeta, a drug that kills
in the womb or one that expels out of the womb, or some other
of the drugs that produce miscarriage and [the man says], "Cause
thy fruit to perish!" and she causes her fruit to perish;
the sin is on the head of all three, the man, the damsel, and
the old woman.

segments.orig:
ýô kainînem upâiti stâtô-
ratûm vâ astâtô-ratûm vâ paradâtãm
vâ aparadâtãm vâ puthrãmca hê
dadhâiti vîspem â ahmât thrâthrem
kerenavât ýat aêsha ýô aperenâyûkô
uzjasât.
segments.en:
'If a man come near unto a damsel, either dependent on the
chief of the family or not dependent, either delivered [unto a
husband] or not delivered, and she conceives by him, so long shall
he support her, until the child be born.

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit harethrem baraiti aêtadha aêsha
ýô aperenâyûkô adhâityô-angharethrem
irishyât para hê irishiñtô raêshem
cikayat baodhô-varshtahe cithaya.
segments.en:
'If he shall not support her, so that the child comes to grief,
for want of proper support, he shall pay for it the penalty for
wilful murder.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýezi tat frajasât añtare
sairi varezâne kahmât mazdayasnanãm harethrem
barât,
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If she be near
her time, which is the worshipper of Mazda that shall support
her?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô kainînem
upâiti stâtô-ratûm vâ astâtô-ratûm
vâ paradâtãm vâ aparadâtãm
vâ vîspem â ahmât thrâthrem kerenavât
ýat aêsha ýô aperenâyûkô
uzjasât.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'If a man come near unto a damsel, either
dependent on the chief of the family or not dependent, either
delivered [unto a husband] or not delivered, and she conceives
by him, so long shall he support her, until the child be born.

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit harethrem baraiti aêtadha hê
vîspå hâirishîsh frâshnaoiti bipaitishtanaca
cathware-paitishtanaca [aêsha bipaitishtâna ýâ
kaine aêsha cathware- paitishtâna ýâ
gadhwa.]
segments.en:
'If he shall not support her ....
'It lies with the faithful to look in the same way after every
pregnant female, either two-footed or four-footed, two-footed
woman or four-footed bitch.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýezi tat frajasât añtare
sairi varezâne kahmât mazdayasnanãm harethrem
barât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If (a bitch)
be near her time, which is the worshipper of Mazda that shall
support her?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô hê

paiti harethrem vîspem â ahmât thrâthrem
kerenavât ýat aête ýôi spâna
uzjasãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He whose house stands nearest, the
care of supporting her is his; so long shall he support her,
until the whelps be born.

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit harethrem baraiti aêtadha aête
ýôi spâna adhâityô-angharethrem

segments.en:
'If he shall not support her, so that the whelps come to grief,
for want of proper support; he shall pay for it the penalty for
wilful murder.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýezica aêsha gadhwa ushtrô-
stânaêshva frajasât kahmât mazdayasnanãm
harethrem barât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a bitch be
near her time and be lying in a stable for camels, which is the
worshipper of Mazda that shall support her?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô aêtem
ushtrô-stânem uzdasta ýenghå vô
aêshô ushtrô-stânish anghat aêtahmâyush
paiti harethrem vîspem â ahmât....
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He who built the stable for camels
or whoso holds it, the care of supporting her is his; so long
shall he support her, until the whelps be born.
'If he shall not support her, so that the whelps come to grief,
for want of proper support, he shall pay for it the penalty for
wilful murder.'

segments.en:

uzdaêzem uzdishta ýenghå vô aêshô
uzdaêzish anghat aêtahmâyush paiti harethrem

'If he shall not support her, so that the whelps come to grief,

segments.en:

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He who dug the moat or whoso holds

her, until the whelps be born.

ýôi spâna adhâityô-angharethrem

segments.en:

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a bitch be
near her time and be lying in the middle of a pasture-field, which
is the worshipper of Mazda that shall support her?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô aêtem
vâstri uzdasta ýenghå vô aêshô
vâstrish anghat aêtahmâyush paiti harethrem,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He who sowed the pasture-field or whoso
holds it, the care of supporting her is his; [so long shall he
support her, until the whelps be bo If he shall not support her,
so that the whelps come to grief, for want of proper support,
he shall pay for it the penalty for wilful murder.]

segments.orig:
upâca hê gâtûm barayen nemô
vañtâhva kãmcit vâ staretaêshinãm
vîspem â ahmât thrâthrem kerenavât
ýat aête ýôi spâna hvâ-zaênem
hvâ-draonem bavãn.
segments.en:
'He shall take her to rest upon a litter of nemovanta or of
any foliage fit for a litter; so long shall he support her, until
the young dogs are capable of self-defence and self-subsistence.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... katha aête spâna hvâ-zaênem
hvâ-draonem bavãn.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When are the
dogs capable of self-defence and self-subsistence?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýavat aête
spâna bish hapta nmâna pairi tacahi bavãn,
vasô pascaêta fraxshtâite aiwi-gâme itha
hama, xshvash månghô sûnô thrâthrem
hapta saredha aperenâyûkahe âthrô ahurahe
mazdå puthrem avatha nâirikayâi!
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'When they
are able to run about in a circuit of twice seven
houses around. Then they may be let loose,
whether it be winter or summer.
'Young dogs ought to be supported for six
months, children for seven years.
'Atar, the son of Ahura Mazda, watches as well
(over a pregnant bitch) as he does over a woman.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezi vasen mazdayasna
jvô-daxshtem maêthmanem kutha tê verezyãn
aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If worshippers
of Mazda want to have a bitch so covered that the offspring shall
be one of a strong nature, what shall they do?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtadha hê
aête mazdayasna ainghå zemô ava-kanem ava-kanayen
maidhyôi pasush-hastaêshva maidhyôi paitishtâne
xrûzhdisme maidhyôi narsh varedusme.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall dig a hole in the earth,
in the middle of the fold half a foot deep if the earth be hard,
half the height of a man if the earth be soft.

segments.orig:
paoiryâi nidarezayen aperenâyûkem avatha
âtrem ahurahe mazdå puthrem vîspem â ahmât
thrâthrem kerenavât ýavat aêshô
spâ anya jasô aiwica aparem patica aparem apâca
paurvaêibya nôit dim avatha irishyãn.
segments.en:
'They shall first tie up [the bitch] there, far from children
and from the Fire, the son of Ahura Mazda, and they shall watch
by her until a dog comes there from anywhere; then another again,
and then a third again, each being kept apart from the former,
lest they should assail one another.

segments.orig:
ýô gadhwãm ýãm aputhrãm
thrayãm bâuzdri barethrica puthrâca paêmainica
ayatâca taêca aêtadhaca puthrem baraiti sûnãm
bâuzdri.
segments.en:
'The bitch being thus covered by three dogs, grows big with
young, and the milk comes to her teats and she brings forth a
young one that is born from several dogs.'

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô gadhwãm jaiñti
ýãm aputhrãm thrayãm bâuzdri
barethrica puthrâca paêmainica ayatâca taêca
aêtadhaca puthrem baraiti sûnãm bâuzdri
kâ hê asti citha.
segments.en:
If a man smite a bitch who has been covered by three dogs,
and who has already milk, and who shall bring forth a young one
born from several dogs, what is the penalty that he shall pay?

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hapta sata upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya hapta sata sraoshô-caranaya!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Seven hundred stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
seven hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
